notes: O ecra A ligar a rede P2P e os cartoes do fim do episodio (avaliacao e agradecimento) tem agora, atras, um wallpaper da obra, escolhido a sorte entre as melhores imagens, escurecido e com fade-in. Ao saltar a avaliacao aparece o cartao Obrigado por assistires connosco!, com Forum, Avaliacoes e Proximo Episodio; quem ja avaliou ve so esse cartao. Os cartoes do fim ficam translucidos e opacos com o rato por cima. Corrigido: ao abrir o Forum ou as Avaliacoes a partir do cartao de agradecimento e fecha-los, o cartao ja nao desaparece.
notesEn: The Connecting to P2P network screen and the end-of-episode cards (rating and thank-you) now have a wallpaper of the title behind them, picked at random from the best images, darkened and with a fade-in. Skipping the rating now opens the Thanks for watching with us! card, with Forum, Ratings and Next Episode; if you already rated, you only see that card. The end cards are translucent and become opaque on mouse hover. Fixed: opening the Forum or Ratings from the thank-you card and closing them no longer makes the card disappear.
